issues.desc: background.md ## Solution Tradeoffs lists options (a)-(d) but ## Conversational Texture references option (e) (decision (e) keep test:koala-residue in npm test chain) which is never defined anywhere in the text. A reader cannot determine what (e) is without external context.

background.md claims Existing 5 REVIEW->TEST preflight gates (channel/concept/lint/docs-drift/codex-adapter) and states adding koala-residue is a sixth slot. In reality, english-artifacts is already a 6th gate in review-preflight.ts (imported at line 75, dispatched at line 475-485, listed in the gate name union type at line 114). The proposed koala-residue gate would be the 7th, not the 6th. index.json description and CHK-002 title also say 6 gates, which would be incorrect. An implementer following the wrong count may mis-position the gate or write incorrect help text.

background.md ## Conversational Texture references stories 1+2+3a+3+4 while ## Trigger Event says Stories 1-3 are DONE. The numbering 3a vs 3 is never explained; a new reader cannot determine whether 3a and 3 are distinct stories or a typo.
